result: Wrote the parent index.md with synthesis (~520 words) and cover.svg drafted. The synthesis pulls the four threads together around three cross-cutting themes: (1) the dominant "stay at Das Achental" move both lodging children converge on, (2) the **1–7 June 2026 closure trap** flagged in both lodging artifacts that overrides every other consideration, and (3) the village overlap between lodging and activities — Aschau, Bernau, Übersee, and Fraueninsel each surface as both candidate accommodation and verified day-trip — including the rival-Michelin tension at Residenz Heinz Winkler and the +49 170 2053542 Nachttaxi trick that makes a Fraueninsel sleep viable.
